coverageReview.conclusion: 15G, 2U and one EPYC 7002/7003; 16 DDR4 RDIMM/LRDIMM slots across eight channels with 1DPC/2DPC independently verified. Front NVMe is Gen3; iDRAC9/OpenManage documented. MI210 is one card in Riser 1B slot 3, restricted to the 24x2.5-inch / 2LP+2FH configuration, HPR fans, 1U HPR heatsink and ambient up to 30C. Dell explicitly listed R7515 available on 17 September 2019; the 17 March 2021 release establishes the later 7003 refresh.

coverageReview.conclusion: 15G, 2U, one/two EPYC 7002/7003; 32 DDR4 RDIMM/LRDIMM slots across eight channels per CPU with 1DPC/2DPC independently verified. One-CPU build requires CPU1, 16 local memory slots, CPU2/memory blanks and only Riser 1. Table 17 names MI100/MI210, up to three in slots 2/5/7 with R1A+R2A+R3A+R4A. Thermal matrix limits liquid builds to two double-width GPUs and excludes 12x3.5 or 24x2.5 NVMe GPU layouts; heatsink/shroud requirements confirmed. Factory DLC and external coolant infrastructure independently documented. September 2019 announcement specified planned early-2020 availability, correctly distinct from its 2021 7003 refresh.

supermicroReview.locator: Processor > Note; System Cooling > Liquid Cooling
supermicroReview.conclusion: Exact SYS-222H-TN page confirms air/liquid CPU cooling through 350W and optional direct-to-chip cold plate. No GPU scope added.

supermicroReview.conclusion: SBA-817V7-1N page explicitly lists air/liquid and maximum 600W CPU TDP with OEM conditions and Coming Soon status preserved.
AS-1126HS-TN Processor Note explicitly states maximum 500W and OEM-specific conditions for air-cooled CPUs above 290W. No liquid option inferred.
AS-2015CS-TNR Processor Note explicitly states maximum 400W and OEM-specific conditions for air-cooled CPUs above 360W. No liquid option inferred.
AS-2115GT-HNTR per-node Processor Note explicitly states maximum 400W and OEM-specific conditions for air-cooled CPUs above 300W. No liquid option inferred.
